quote.translation: Contingency of this kind has a certain literary value in the forms of alliteration, end rhyme, the pivot word (kakekotoba), the pillow word (makurakotoba), the acrostic (oriku) and the palindrome (kaibun) (cf. Iwanami kōza Nihon bungaku, Kuki, "Nihon shi no ōin", p. 8, p. 119, p. 155).

regions.text: 枕詞に焼て云へば「百数の、大宮どころ」「草枕、旅やどりせす」などにあつては枕詞と次の七字句との措定は意味の論理開係によつて互に必然に制約されてある。

quote.translation: To take pillow words first, in momoshiki no, ōmiyadokoro and kusamakura, tabiyadori sesu the positing of the pillow word and of the seven-syllable phrase that follows are mutually and necessarily conditioned by a logical relation of meaning.

regions.text: 然るに「稻舟のいなにはあらす」「うの花のうきことあれや」など頭によるものや、「玉垂の、を（緒、越）智の大野の」「梓号、はる（張春）の山べを」など掛詞によるものは、いづれもみな枕詞と次の七字旬との間に眞の理由性を使くもので、單に音韻上の偶然開係が存するのみである。

quote.translation: In those that rest on alliteration, however, such as inafune no, ina ni wa arazu and u no hana no, uki koto are ya, and in those that rest on a pivot word, such as tamadare no, o-chi no ōno no, where o is both 緒 and 越, and azusayumi, haru no yamabe o, where haru is both "to string" (張) and "spring" (春), true groundedness is lacking between the pillow word and the following seven-syllable phrase, and there is only a contingent relation of sound.

regions.text: なほ掛詞の本質は、一つの音を異つた二つの意味に分解して、二つの意味の有する音番上の偶然符合を把撮するのである。

quote.translation: The essence of the pivot word, further, is to split one sound into two different meanings and to grasp the contingent coincidence of sound that the two meanings share.

regions.text: 脚額に就て云へば洛腸城東桃李花」といふ句は論理開係によつて各々の語が必然に制約されてるる。「飛來飛去落誰家といふ句も同様である。さてこの雨句の間には「花と「寒」が共に平聲麻韻であるといふ音上の性格によつて、言語の意味による理由性とは何等の関係ない偶然的關係が設立されてあるのである。

quote.translation: As for end rhyme, in the line "East of the city of Luoyang, the peach and plum blossom" each word is necessarily conditioned by logical relation, and the same is true of the line "Flying here, flying there, into whose house does it fall?", yet between the two lines a contingent relation, having nothing to do with the groundedness of the words' meaning, is established through the phonological character that 花, "blossom", and 家, "house", both belong to the level tone and the 麻 rhyme.

regions.text: 「奥つ鳥（1）鴨者く島に（1）我がの寝し（f）嫌は忘れじ（）世のことことに（」）』は一韻到底の個然的開係によって

quote.translation: The poem okitsu tori (i) / kamo doku shima ni (i) / waga ineshi (i) / imo wa wasureji (i) / yo no kotogoto ni (i), by the contingent relation of a single rhyme held throughout, forms a recurring circular movement repeated without end.
